query:
SELECT COALESCE(
                    jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                        'code', code, 'label', label, 'color', color_hex, 'icon', icon)
                      ORDER BY sort_order, code),
                    '[]'::jsonb) AS "themes!"
             FROM reference.taxonomy_terms
            WHERE taxonomy_code = 'activity_theme' AND is_active
